title: Riddler Xochi layered fee_breakdown
description: Wire shape of the layered `fee_breakdown` object returned by POST /xochi/quote (SPEC.md Section 4). Rates are basis points (integers); amounts are token base-unit integer strings. The deterministic core (tier/asset_class/*_bps/*_fee/total_bps/total_fee/surplus_share_pct) is reproduced by the reference implementation and pinned in fee/vectors.json; gas_floor and *_usd are price-oracle-derived and validated for shape only.

tier.description: Trust tier the fee was priced at (after any attestation gating).

asset_class.description: Settlement asset tier; drives the solver/venue/routing schedule.

gas_floor.description: Never-discounted network cost floor (cost-to-fill x margin). Price-oracle-derived; added by the quote adapter.

solver_fee_bps.description: Solver spread. Never discounted; the cost floor.

price_impact_bps.description: Size-vs-depth slippage. A solver cost, never discounted; 0 on deep/unknown books.

routing_fee_bps.description: Routing (Raxol) cut. Tier-discounted; 0 when origin = acp.

total_bps.description: solver + price_impact + venue + routing, clamped >= solver_fee_bps.

total_fee.description: Sum of the four per-layer amounts (each floored independently).

surplus_share_pct.description: Percent of positive fill slippage captured; the remainder returns to the taker.

amount.description: Non-negative integer in the origin token's base units.
